item.title: New Raw Speed RS-2 B7 Buggy Body
item.description: Take your 1/10 buggy to the next level with the RawSpeed RS-2 Body — a race engineered body designed for maximum performance on modern high-grip tracks.

item.title: JConcepts Reactor Monster Truck Teaser [VIDEO]
item.description: JConcepts has released the teaser video for the Reactor Monster Truck project which is an adjustable wheelbase retro style monster truck.

item.title: New RC Discharger Modular Pit Command Center
item.description: The new RC Discharger modular stand system is built around interchangeable components that let every driver customize their setup, whether they run a single 1/12 scale car or a 3-class fleet.

item.title: New Hudy Setup Board Adjustable Feet
item.description: The HUDY Adjustable Set-up Board Feet allows for an independent height adjustment of each corner of the set-up board, to accommodate for the surface that the set-up board sits on.

item.title: New Rawspeed Interceptor MX8E-25 Body
item.description: The RawSpeed Interceptor for the Mayako MX8E-25 is engineered to DOMINATE — cab-forward teardrop aggression, razor-sharp aero lines, and insane downforce that pins your buggy to the track like it's glued.

item.title: New XB4 Narrow Front Side Guards
item.description: The Team Xray XB4 V3 graphite side guards are precision-engineered components designed to optimize chassis performance and consistency on high traction surfaces.

item.title: 2026 Snowbirds On-Road Q3 Update
item.description: The 32nd Annual Snowbirds event is taking place in Kissimmee, Florida and after 3 rounds of qualifying the racing is extremely tight.

item.title: New Exotek RC10 Adjustable Aluminum Rear Hubs
item.description: Exotek has released new heavy duty, precision machined 7075 alloy rear hub set for the RC10 line of vehicles.

item.title: New Hudy 1/12th Scale Tire Stand/Holder With Case
item.description: The HUDY Tire Stand is an essential accessory for organizing your tires. This stylish and highly functional stand keeps your pit space tidy and makes it easy to track your various tire sets.

item.title: New Team GFRP Assault HB'24 to 26 HBS Conversion Kit
item.description: This kit from Team GFRP includes the basics needed to convert a 2024 Assault HBS to a 2026 HBS (high bite sprint).
